editorial:
Imagine three best friends working as flight attendants in Mumbai, just trying to make ends meet while dreaming of a bigger life. You get to follow these women as they deal with annoying bosses and money troubles, which makes them feel like people you actually know. The vibe is light and breezy, feeling more like a fun hangout than a heavy drama. It is basically a story about friendship and the lengths people will go to when they are desperate for a payday, all wrapped in a bright, colorful package that keeps you smiling.

What really makes it work is the chemistry between the leads; they bounce off each other perfectly and keep the energy high. While the plot is a bit predictable and some jokes feel a little recycled, the fast pacing ensures you never get bored. If you are looking for a stress-free movie night, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: After a wild ride of gold smuggling and narrow escapes, the trio manages to outsmart the villains and the authorities. They use their wit to secure the money they need without getting caught in the act. In the end, the friends stay loyal to each other and find a way to achieve their dreams. They move past their misfortunes, proving that their bond is stronger than any crime or chaos they faced together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves lighthearted heist comedies and stories about female friendship.
